supported_agent: Claude, Codex, Agy, Pi and Cursor with exact session references
install_scope: Explicit Install button on the displayed direct SSH host, or user-selected manual directory. No install on opening Timeline, sudo, hooks or persistent service.
requirements: Rust 1.85 or later for a source build
Unix host with the current agent session directory readable by the SSH user; Pi controls also require the opt-in extension in Pi 1.4.0

steps.description: Build on the target host; Cargo.lock fixes dependency versions
Probe without opening Herdr or reading transcripts
Install explicitly; executes the selected trusted binary for compatibility checking
For updates, use the same install command with --replace; symlink destinations are rejected
Open a supported agent pane in Herdcats over direct SSH; Timeline launches the helper on demand

failure_behavior: Absent native history leaves legacy Compose and Terminal available. A verified native identity retains ownership/status guards. Installation is never triggered by opening Timeline.
removal: Remove only the installed herdcats-bridge file. No daemon, hooks or config are created by this installer.
limits: Published native release builds/tests verified in CI
Public installer smoke verified on Apple Silicon in a temporary directory

Native approvals and questions are available from 0.3.0 with capability negotiation and opt-ins. Claude approval/question cards and Codex approval cards require the hook; Codex question cards do not. Saved-machine routing remains unavailable

onboarding.status: 0.5.0 published and pinned; minimum compatible version 0.5.0
app_flow: For a supported agent, missing helper automatically opens near-full-screen Timeline benefits and host-helper setup guidance
Dismiss or Use Terminal for now selects Terminal and remembers the SSH-host choice
Timeline toolbar icon retries and reopens guidance while helper is missing
Display SSH host/user/port and ~/.local/bin/herdcats-bridge before an explicit Install action

Probe existing helper, then install pinned release with progress; a managed older copy upgrades in one tap from the Upgrade drawer, while an unmanaged copy elsewhere still needs explicit confirmation and is left unchanged
After uncertain installation, check existing helper before allowing a retry; retain Manual setup copy instructions
Check again remains in guidance when unavailable; verified native Timeline closes the sheet and restores its default
onboarding.publication: 0.5.0 release assets and installer checksum verified for the iOS pin
onboarding.download_boundary: HTTPS release assets and same-channel SHA256SUMS; checksums are integrity checks, not independent signing
onboarding.build_dependencies: Rust and Python are required only for source-build/development path below
onboarding.app_installer_integrity: App pins bridge 0.5.0 and install.sh SHA256 64d19e790f6256db5c4fc3b28240bbe9462b32268c3afd541befe7505ea6397a before execution. Minimum compatible bridge version is 0.5.0; older or unverifiable handshakes require an explicit upgrade. Installer checks native binary checksum.
onboarding.agent_support: Published installer supports Claude, Codex, Agy, Pi and Cursor. Pi extension installation and enabling remain a separate opt-in step.
onboarding.record_content: App requires negotiated record_content support; older helpers reopen setup and require explicit replacement. Images and unfamiliar records expose complete source bytes.

source_support.agy: Supported by the published 0.5.0 installer. Agy model controls and interactions retain native-session and verified-build guards.
source_support.cursor: Supported by the published 0.5.0 installer. Model control is verified on Cursor build 2026.10.22-27dcf5f only.
source_support.pi: Requires the opt-in extension in herdcats-pi-extension.tar.gz (or bridge/pi-extension from source), enabled inside Pi 1.4.0. Binary installation alone does not enable Pi controls.
